working: Constant Contact is connected and pulling fresh data again (100 campaigns, data through the 8/19 send) after being stuck on cached 7/20 data last run.

The August alumni series is landing: Alumni eNews Reminder (8/16) coincided with a +686% session spike (23.5 baseline to 184.7 daily) and the Day-Of send (8/19) added +52% lift with a 44.25% open rate.
Open rates remain far above the 25-35% health benchmark: 51.21% average across the last 100 campaigns; only 1 of 91 tracked sends opened below 25%.
SEO ticked up vs the 8/20 run: GSC clicks 53 to 58 and impressions 4,126 to 4,382 week over week, with Organic Search holding 33.1% of all traffic (10,777 sessions).
Historically the biggest movers are alumni-event and client-news sends: Client eNews August 2024 (+1263% lift), Client eNews December 2023 (10.17% click rate).
not_working: UTM leakage is nearly total: across 88 measured sends, only 15 sessions were credited to Email in the 3 days post-send vs 6,079 to Direct; the 8/16 reminder alone showed 513 Direct sessions vs 1 Email. Newsletter links carry no UTM tags, so GA4 mis-credits Email traffic as Direct (Email shows 20 sessions, 0.1%, across the whole window).

Click rates are weak relative to opens: 1.89% average click vs 51.21% average open (about 3.7% click-to-open). Staff-Client eNews July 2026 managed only 0.43% clicks to 8,906 recipients and a -27.3% lift.
26 of 88 measured sends produced zero or negative session lift, so roughly 30% of sends move no traffic.
Organic Social is stuck at 5.3% of sessions (1,720) and slipped slightly vs last run; impression-weighted GSC position also drifted from 14.19 to 14.4.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email (plus utm_campaign per send) to every newsletter link so the ~6,000 Direct-credited post-send sessions attribute to Email; this is the single highest-value fix.
Keep the send + mid-month reminder cadence: the 8/16 reminder outperformed the 8/13 original send by a wide margin (+686% vs +19% lift); reminders are doing the heavy lifting.

Repromote alumni-event and client-news themes, the historical top performers by lift and click (Client eNews Aug 2024 +1263%, Dec 2023 10.17% click); rework Staff-Client eNews with fewer items and one clear CTA to fix its 0.43% click rate.
Watch GSC position (14.19 to 14.4 drift); clicks are growing, but check the tracked-keyword trend in the SEO pulse before the next content push.
summary: Constant Contact reporting is live again and the August alumni series drove real traffic (+686% spike around the 8/16 reminder), but nearly all of it lands in GA4 as Direct because newsletter links have no UTM tags. Tagging links is the top priority; SEO clicks and impressions ticked up week over week.
